The unmodified resource contains Brave's 5,824 bundled baseline WebKit rules.
This is not the full Brave Shields implementation. List-derived rights and
notices need additional review before public distribution. Inclusion here is
for controlled development and personal device testing. Fennavio is not
affiliated with Brave.
